[bold]RESEARCH PROMPT:[/bold] Can you do some research with the goal of comparing sase with gastown, with a particular
focus on the things that gastown does better than sase? End your analysis with a ranked
list of ways that gastown is superior to sase along with a (not necessarily one-to-one)
ranked list of recommended changes you think I should consider making to sase based on
your report's findings.
